documents.description:
ROUND 1. SURFACE: internal/agent/report.go, internal/agent/report_test.go.

WHAT IS TRUE ON origin/main 95642c550 and in the control-plane database, measured 2026-08-07:
- No agent_version key exists on ANY box's health payload across 1,801 beats in 6 h. The beat cannot say which binary produced it.
- That matters because the fleet is split by binary age and nothing reports it: over 48 h and 10,974 beats, cpu_cores is present on 766 Guerrilla beats and on ZERO beats of Gyldendal, dooodo, gyl and jarl; the same holds for load15 and swap_used_percent. Guerrilla's /usr/local/bin/barkpark-agent is dated Aug 7 02:36; jarl's is Jul 30 14:25.
- So a fence that divides by cpu_cores is structurally uncomputable on four of five boxes, and from the data alone that is INDISTINGUISHABLE from four healthy boxes. This is the epic's own disease inside the instrument that measures the instruments (charter D140).
- The only route to the producer's identity was the binary's mtime over SSH, and that route just closed on two of five boxes: SSH to dooodo (116.203.91.216) and gyl (46.225.61.223) now fails with REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED (known_hosts:54 and :53) while both boxes beat normally.

WHAT TO BUILD. Put the agent's own version on every health beat. Emit agent_version as a string field on the report struct in internal/agent/report.go, sourced from whatever build stamp the binary already carries (a linker-injected version var, or the module build info via runtime/debug.ReadBuildInfo). No control-plane change is needed to land it: the CP stores the beat payload as RAW jsonb, so `select payload->>'agent_version'` works the moment a box ships the new agent.

FAIL CLOSED, NOT SILENT. If the version genuinely cannot be determined, emit an explicit unknown marker consistent with this agent's existing honesty convention for unmeasured values (see how ReqPerS/P95Ms use the -1 sentinel at report.go:137-141 and 398-399 — mirror the INTENT, choose a string-appropriate form, and document it in a comment). Never emit an empty string that a reader would treat as a measured value, and never omit the key so that its absence means two different things.

DO NOT change any existing field, do not touch the health gate, and do not touch the control plane — this slice is agent-side only and its whole value is that it lands with zero CP work.

STATE IN THE PR BODY that this does not itself deliver a newer agent to the fleet: dr-bl-w6-cut-and-bless-v0-2-26 is the human gate for that, and until it fires, a box with no agent_version key is exactly the class this field exists to name.
